apple.name: Since & Soon
apple.subtitle: Countdowns & days since
apple.promotionalText: The days ahead. The moments behind. Count down and count up with photos, illustrated backgrounds, flexible reminders, widgets, and countdowns you can share.
apple.description:
Make room for the days that matter.

Since & Soon counts down to the days you’re looking forward to and counts up from the moments you want to remember. Birthdays, trips, weddings, anniversaries, a new habit, a fresh start: give each one a place of its own.

LOOK FORWARD WITH SOON
See what’s coming next and watch the countdown change. Count in days, weeks, sleeps, or hours, and set yearly repeats for dates that come around again.

LOOK BACK WITH SINCE
Keep track of how long it’s been since something began. Celebrate your progress, remember your favorite moments, and set reminders for milestones.

MAKE EVERY EVENT YOURS
Choose a photo or explore colors, gradients, patterns, textures, and illustrated backgrounds. Add an icon and pick a font to make each event feel like you.

REMEMBER THE DATE
Set reminders for the day itself or ahead of time. Keep important dates close with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

SHARE A LITTLE ANTICIPATION
Create a story or square countdown image, copy a countdown as text, or share an event as a calendar file.

GIVE YOUR DAYS A BIGGER PICTURE
On iPad, browse events beside a live countdown or turn your tablet into a countdown board with wall mode.

No account needed. Your events are saved on your device.

For the days ahead. And the days behind.
apple.whatsNew:
Countdowns is now Since & Soon.

• A completely redesigned app with warm paper, bold numbers, and a touch of highlighter.
• Soon counts down to the days ahead. Since counts up from the moments behind.
• Personalize events with photos, colors, gradients, patterns, textures, illustrations, icons, and fonts.
• Choose days, weeks, sleeps, or hours.
• Set reminders and yearly repeats, and celebrate milestones.
• Keep events close with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
• Enjoy a roomy iPad layout and countdown wall mode.
• Share countdown images, copy countdown text, or send a calendar file.
• Choose from a refreshed collection of app icons.
